latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of compliance-audit-pro – an automated compliance audit engine for legal, finance, and procurement scenarios.

- Extracts risk clauses and maps them to specified compliance baselines and laws.
- Supports automated risk assessment with configurable thresholds (low/medium/high/strict).
- Generates standardized audit workpapers, clarification templates, and compliance reports in Markdown format.
- Compatible with OpenClaw, Dify, Coze, and SkillHub platforms.
